# 1 Enoch Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Now watch the summer days — the sun blazes overhead, and you have to go looking for shade just to survive the heat. The whole earth is scorched. You cannot even walk on the ground or step on bare rock — it is all too hot to touch.

---

*PNEUMA notes: The single-verse chapter delivers the most viscerally physical observation in the nature series. The dynamic rendering foregrounds the human experience of summer heat — the compulsion to seek shade, the impossibility of walking on hot ground — as evidence that the sun faithfully and powerfully fulfills its appointed role. This contrasts sharply with humanity's failure (ch. 5).*
